mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_persona_source( id, owner_user_id, visibility, adapter_type, display_name, persona_kind, description, source_url, source_ref, source_commit, artifact_hash, upstream_schema_version, raw_artifact_path, is_real_person, is_public_figure, relationship_ceiling, creator, created_at, updater, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{personaId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{visibility}, #{adapterType}, #{displayName}, #{personaKind}, #{description}, #{sourceUrl}, #{sourceRef}, #{sourceCommit}, #{artifactHash}, #{upstreamSchemaVersion}, #{artifactPath}, #{realPerson}, #{publicFigure}, #{relationshipCeiling}, #{ownerUserId}, NOW(), #{ownerUserId}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(display_name), display_name), persona_kind = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(persona_kind), persona_kind), description = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(description), description), source_url = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(source_url), source_url), source_ref = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(source_ref), source_ref), source_commit = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(source_commit), source_commit), artifact_hash = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(artifact_hash), artifact_hash), upstream_schema_version = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(upstream_schema_version), upstream_schema_version), raw_artifact_path = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(raw_artifact_path), raw_artifact_path), is_real_person = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(is_real_person), is_real_person), is_public_figure = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(is_public_figure), is_public_figure), relationship_ceiling = IF(latest_published_version IS NULL, VALUES(relationship_ceiling), relationship_ceiling), updater = VALUES(updater), updated_at = NOW()

SELECT version, parent_version AS parentVersion, revision_no AS revisionNo, compiled_hash AS compiledHash, status FROM ai_persona_version WHERE persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND compiled_hash = #{compiledHash} AND (version = #{revisionRoot} OR parent_version = #{revisionRoot}) ORDER BY revision_no DESC, created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS personaId, s.display_name AS displayName, s.description, s.avatar_path AS avatarPath, s.persona_kind AS personaKind, s.visibility, s.source_url AS sourceUrl, s.source_commit AS sourceCommit, s.relationship_ceiling AS relationshipCeiling, s.latest_published_version AS publishedVersion, s.previous_published_version AS previousVersion, ( SELECT v.version FROM ai_persona_version v WHERE v.persona_source_id = s.id AND v.status = 'draft' ORDER BY v.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS pendingVersion, (s.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AS owned, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_persona_source s WHERE (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC

SELECT s.id AS personaId, s.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, s.display_name AS displayName, s.description, s.avatar_path AS avatarPath, s.persona_kind AS personaKind, s.visibility, s.source_url AS sourceUrl, s.source_ref AS sourceRef, s.source_commit AS sourceCommit, s.artifact_hash AS artifactHash, s.raw_artifact_path AS rawArtifactPath, s.is_real_person AS realPerson, s.is_public_figure AS publicFigure, s.relationship_ceiling AS relationshipCeiling, s.latest_published_version AS publishedVersion, s.previous_published_version AS previousVersion, ( SELECT v.version FROM ai_persona_version v WHERE v.persona_source_id = s.id AND v.status = 'draft' ORDER BY v.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS pendingVersion, (s.owner_user_id = #{userId}) AS owned, s.created_at AS createdAt, s.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ai_persona_source s WHERE s.id = #{personaId} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) LIMIT 1

SELECT v.version, v.parent_version AS parentVersion, v.revision_no AS revisionNo, v.artifact_hash AS artifactHash, v.source_commit AS sourceCommit, v.source_artifact_path AS sourceArtifactPath, v.compiler_version AS compilerVersion, v.compiled_hash AS compiledHash, v.token_count AS tokenCount, v.quality_score AS qualityScore, v.test_status AS testStatus, v.status, CASE WHEN v.version = s.latest_published_version THEN 'current' WHEN v.version = s.previous_published_version THEN 'previous' ELSE 'candidate' END AS lifecycleRole, v.created_at AS createdAt, v.published_at AS publishedAt FROM ai_persona_version v JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = v.persona_source_id WHERE v.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) AND ( v.version = s.latest_published_version OR v.version = s.previous_published_version OR v.version = ( SELECT candidate.version FROM ( SELECT v2.version FROM ai_persona_version v2 WHERE v2.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND v2.status = 'draft' ORDER BY v2.created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) candidate ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN v.version = s.latest_published_version THEN 0 WHEN v.status = 'draft' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END

SELECT v.version, v.parent_version AS parentVersion, v.revision_no AS revisionNo, v.artifact_hash AS artifactHash, v.source_commit AS sourceCommit, v.source_artifact_path AS sourceArtifactPath, v.compiler_version AS compilerVersion, v.compiled_hash AS compiledHash, v.token_count AS tokenCount, v.quality_score AS qualityScore, v.test_status AS testStatus, CAST(v.test_report AS CHAR) AS testReport, v.status, CAST(v.validation_report AS CHAR) AS validationReport, CAST(v.canonical_spec_json AS CHAR) AS canonicalSpec, v.runtime_prompt AS runtimePrompt, v.created_at AS createdAt, v.published_at AS publishedAt FROM ai_persona_version v JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = v.persona_source_id WHERE v.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND v.version = #{version} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) LIMIT 1

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_persona_signature_asset( id, persona_source_id, persona_version, signature_key, variant, content_type, original_filename, audio_data, byte_size, sha256, owner_user_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{personaId}, #{version}, #{signatureKey}, #{variant}, #{contentType}, #{originalFilename}, #{audioData}, #{byteSize}, #{sha256}, #{ownerUserId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = VALUES(id), content_type = VALUES(content_type), original_filename = VALUES(original_filename), audio_data = VALUES(audio_data), byte_size = VALUES(byte_size), sha256 = VALUES(sha256), owner_user_id = VALUES(owner_user_id), updated_at = NOW()

mapper.update: UPDATE ai_persona_source s JOIN ai_persona_version v ON v.persona_source_id = s.id AND v.version = #{version} AND v.status = 'published' SET s.previous_published_version = s.latest_published_version, s.latest_published_version = v.version, s.display_name = COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.display_name')), ''), s.display_name), s.description = COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.identity.summary')), ''), s.description), s.relationship_ceiling = COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.relationship_policy.ceiling')), ''), s.relationship_ceiling), s.is_real_person = CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'true' THEN 1 WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE s.is_real_person END, s.is_public_figure = CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_public_figure')) = 'true' THEN 1 WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_public_figure')) = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE s.is_public_figure END, s.persona_kind = CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_public_figure')) = 'true' THEN 'public_figure' WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'true' THEN 'real_person' WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'false' THEN 'fictional' ELSE s.persona_kind END, s.source_commit = COALESCE(v.source_commit, s.source_commit), s.artifact_hash = COALESCE(v.artifact_hash, s.artifact_hash), s.raw_artifact_path = COALESCE(v.source_artifact_path, s.raw_artifact_path), s.updated_at = NOW(), s.updater = #{userId} WHERE s.id = #{personaId} AND s.owner_user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE ai_persona_source s JOIN ai_persona_version v ON v.persona_source_id = s.id AND v.version = #{previousVersion} AND v.status = 'published' SET s.latest_published_version = #{previousVersion}, s.previous_published_version = #{currentVersion}, s.display_name = COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.display_name')), ''), s.display_name), s.description = COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.identity.summary')), ''), s.description), s.relationship_ceiling = COALESCE( NULLIF(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.relationship_policy.ceiling')), ''), s.relationship_ceiling), s.is_real_person = CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'true' THEN 1 WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE s.is_real_person END, s.is_public_figure = CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_public_figure')) = 'true' THEN 1 WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_public_figure')) = 'false' THEN 0 ELSE s.is_public_figure END, s.persona_kind = CASE WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_public_figure')) = 'true' THEN 'public_figure' WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'true' THEN 'real_person' WHEN JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.canonical_spec_json, '$.source.is_real_person')) = 'false' THEN 'fictional' ELSE s.persona_kind END, s.source_commit = COALESCE(v.source_commit, s.source_commit), s.artifact_hash = COALESCE(v.artifact_hash, s.artifact_hash), s.raw_artifact_path = COALESCE(v.source_artifact_path, s.raw_artifact_path), s.updater = #{userId}, s.updated_at = NOW() WHERE s.id = #{personaId} AND s.owner_user_id = #{userId} AND s.latest_published_version = #{currentVersion} AND s.previous_published_version = #{previousVersion}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_persona_test_run( id, persona_source_id, version, suite_version, model_config_id, status, created_by, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{personaId}, #{version}, #{suiteVersion}, #{modelConfigId}, 'pending', #{createdBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.suite_version AS suiteVersion, r.model_config_id AS modelConfigId, r.status, CAST(r.score_json AS CHAR) AS scoreJson, CAST(r.report_json AS CHAR) AS reportJson, r.created_by AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_persona_test_run r JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = r.persona_source_id WHERE r.persona_source_id = #{personaId} AND r.version = #{version} AND (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT a.id, a.action, a.target_type AS targetType, a.target_id AS targetId, CAST(a.details_json AS CHAR) AS detailsJson, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM ai_companion_audit a JOIN ai_persona_source s ON s.id = #{personaId} WHERE (s.owner_user_id = #{userId} OR s.visibility IN ('shared', 'public')) AND (a.target_id = #{personaId} OR a.target_id LIKE CONCAT(#{personaId}, '@%') OR a.target_id LIKE CONCAT(#{personaId}, ':%')) ORDER BY a.created_at DESC LIMIT 100
